text.en:
The importation of breeder and slaughter cattle, goats, and beef (choice cuts and briskets) shall
be done by the government through this large-scale experimental ranching project, being pioneered in and
placed under the management of King Ranch.

That such importation shall have prior approval of the Department of Agriculture, through the
Bureau of Animal Industry.

The Bureau of Animal Industry shall promulgate rules and regulations for the effective
implementation of this Decree.

The Budget Commission shall appropriate annually the amount of Twenty Million Pesos
(P20,000,000.00) for the importation of breeder cattle, and goats for experimental and dispersal purposes, as
well as beef (choice cuts and briskets).

Any violation of any provision of this Decree or the rules and regulations to be promulgated
pursuant herewith shall be punishable, upon conviction, by imprisonment of not less than one year nor more

than two years, or by a fine of not less than Four Thousand nor more than Six Thousand Pesos, or both, at the
discretion of the court.

Any provision of law, order, decree, or Letter of Instruction inconsistent with provisions of this
Decree is hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
